newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Kinnevik sells NetCom shares for 110 Skr each.
newsitem.headline: Kinnevik sells NetCom shares for 110 Skr each.

text.p: Swedish holding and media company Kinnevik said on Friday it will sell six million shares in telecoms group NetCom Systems for 110 crowns a share, making a capital gain of about 165 million crowns.
The offering will take place in connection with NetCom's issue of two million new series B shares, the company said in a statement.
Before selling the shares, Kinnevik will convert convertibles to shares. Kinnevik received the convertibles when it spun-off and listed its former subsidiary NetCom in May, 1996.
After the sale, assuming it is successful, Kinnevik will hold NetCom convertibles corresponding to 755,555 series B shares or 0.7 percent of capital and 0.3 percent of votes.
